solver.constant_feature_rule: exactly identical training entries: center at repeated value, scale1; otherwise mean and population std(ddof0)

knn_tie_break: most recent origin first, then retain selected origins chronologically
tuning_score: mean final projected C versus P pinball in source-native units; weights exactly float(19/20),float(1/20)
validation_incomplete_policy: any failed or incomplete declared candidate makes whole source/H/W/family cell ineligible; retain all candidates and failures
evaluation_incomplete_policy: stop whole source/H/W/family cell; no complete accuracy mean, row deletion, fallback or different parameter
nonoverlap: evaluation_start+j*(H+1), no calendar-year reset, H-specific grids, no independence assertion

fx_hourly.interpretation: already inspected evaluation archive; new comparison exploratory

nyfed_weekly.interpretation: downloaded-vintage as-of-index aggregate market-value replay; not live public data or individual dealer validation

common_procedure_contrasts: every selected family versus frozen_F, frozen_S, frozen_K at same source/H/W and refit schedule
update_contrasts: rolling versus frozen F/S/K at same source/H/W

phase_inventory.validation: source in listed order, horizon in listed order, window in listed order, family in listed order; three candidates increasing numeric order
phase_inventory.selection_freeze: all declared validation receipts and their hashes, exact parameters or null; before evaluation
phase_inventory.evaluation: same source/H/W/family cells; selected parameter only, or terminal ineligible status
phase_inventory.references: source/H/W cells, rolling_F/S/K and frozen_F/S/K; one_state_F/S/K only when declared neighbor count non-null
phase_inventory.retry: identical code/spec/source only, every attempt retained with explicit technical reason; no changed scientific or numerical choices
